crons.name: HL Strategy Lab — Weekly Deep Eval

quality.reason: Well-structured output with sourced, timestamped, actionable signals (whale 30x BTC short with liquidation price, ETF net flows), engagement metrics, confidence scores, and direct links; only minor weakness is the low-relevance raffle item diluting the signal set.

Well-formatted health/PnL summary provides some value, but the core signals section is redundant noise (4 near-identical low-strength BTC signals from one scanner with no direction or actionable detail) and the news section contains a broken link placeholder, making the output mostly status theater rather than actionable signal.

Well-structured output with clear position status, per-pair strategy scores with margins and trends, and a genuinely actionable anomaly flag (SOL stochastic missing from top 10) that warrants strategy reassignment review.

Quantified threshold-based book-imbalance alerts (e.g., BTC 94% ask-weighted) are genuinely actionable and well-formatted, but the header alerts duplicate the table data, identical funding rates across all coins suggest a stale or default-valued field, and the output appears truncated mid-table.

Delivers concrete actionable signal—specific classifier misratings (e.g., $1B Solana ETF flagged 'low') with matched keywords and a fully reconciled queue (0 unreported)—though it reads as process narration rather than a polished final deliverable.

Dense, well-structured daily review with trend deltas, quantified metrics, and clearly flagged actionable failures (meta-agent 136.8d no briefs, paper-trader stuck 51d, whale-monitor 0% uptime, news-agent down to 1 source) — strong signal-to-noise ratio with only minor cryptic abbreviations.
Output is corrupted artifacts—leaked internal monologue, raw Python/shell code fragments, and XML arg tags—with no actual arXiv research digest content despite the API being blocked.

Concrete, quantified progress report (24,100 rows added, 4 efficient API calls) with honest caveats and clear status on a known timezone bug, though the deferred bug and 25 unevaluated signals lack explicit follow-up plans.
